title.quote: Delays in Care for Children With Low Anorectal Malformations in Southwestern Uganda

analysis.description: The paper investigates the delays in diagnosis and treatment of children with low anorectal malformations in Southwestern Uganda. It utilizes the Three Delays model to identify and analyze the factors contributing to these delays.

type.justification: The study involves a cross-sectional analysis examining real-world issues related to delays in care within a specific population.
type.quote: Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study examining the delays in care among children with low ARMs in Southwestern Uganda between June 2021 and July 2023.

name.justification: The research is focused on the disparities in healthcare outcomes for pediatric surgical conditions in a specific region.
name.quote: Introduction: Disparities in anorectal malformation (ARM) outcomes between high- and low-income countries may be due to delayed diagnosis in the latter setting.

name.justification: The study addresses issues related to healthcare access and equity in a low-income country.
